owner_feedback.summary: The current design is perceived as very weak and not sufficiently sophisticated; improve the system-level design capability and continue the site with much stronger art direction and motion.

visitor: Parent, child, teenager or adult considering Shinkyokushinkai karate in Nizhny Novgorod or Dzerzhinsk.
primary_job: Feel the physical culture and credibility of the federation, then quickly choose a hall/instructor and make direct contact.
first_impression: A living martial-arts federation presented like a contemporary sports editorial/poster system, not a generic gym landing page.
first_screen_must_communicate: clear path to choose a section

design_direction.name: Dojo Editorial / Competition Poster
design_direction.composition: Asymmetric editorial grid with full-bleed documentary photography, poster-scale typography, sharp section transitions and selective rule/grid geometry inspired by tatami and competition structure.
design_direction.typography: Strong Cyrillic-capable condensed/display voice plus clean reading voice; deliberate line breaks and poster-like labels; no tiny-uppercase-everywhere pseudo-premium styling.
design_direction.photography: Fewer, larger real federation images; aggressive but identity-safe crops; action -> people -> proof -> invitation narrative.
design_direction.materiality: Black ink, warm paper/ivory, federation red, hard rules, subtle grain/print-register cues; no glassmorphism or decorative gradient blobs.
design_direction.navigation: Minimal editorial navigation with line/position states rather than rounded SaaS pills.
design_direction.cards: Use cards only for real object/task boundaries. Avoid repeating identical rounded rectangles as the page skeleton.
design_direction.practical_directory: The halls/schedule area becomes a clear sports directory/catalog: strong filter rail, compact rows/cards, readable addresses and direct phone/map actions.

motion_grammar.entry: Hero typography and image establish energy with restrained mask/translate choreography; no loader and no content dependency on animation.
motion_grammar.scroll: Low-amplitude photo parallax, chapter/reveal masks and section progress; transforms/opacity only for continuous motion.
motion_grammar.interaction: Directional underline/edge motion, image focus shifts and tactile buttons; no universal card zoom.
motion_grammar.state_change: Filters and navigation preserve spatial continuity and exact URL state.
motion_grammar.reduced_motion: All decorative parallax/mask choreography disabled or reduced to opacity while content and state remain complete.

properties: rounded/pill UI borrowed from SaaS patterns
red/radial-gradient decoration doing too much of the art-direction work
generic fade-up reveal used as primary motion language
trainer and gallery sections feel like component grids rather than editorial storytelling
more animation used to hide weak typography or photography

forbidden_substitutions: synthetic trainer/customer/athlete imagery implying real identity
decorative Japanese glyphs or calligraphy with unverified meaning
motion that blocks access to content

perceptual_qa.blocker: Current execution Chromium refuses local/file navigation with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR; source-only review cannot be promoted to PERCEPTUAL_REVIEW_PASS.
